hero.title: Hope Lights the Way
hero.subtitle1: Even in the darkest night, a single spark can guide us to a better tomorrow.
hero.subtitle2: After the rain comes the sun. Find your strength to rise again.

hope.title: Hope
hope.description:
Hope is the pillar that holds up the world.
- Pliny the Elder (Roman Author)

life.title: Life
life.description:
Live as if you were to die tomorrow.
Learn as if you were to live forever.
- Mahatma Gandhi (Indian Lawyer & Ethicist)

possibility.title: Possibility
possibility.description:
It is never too late to be what you might have been.
- George Eliot (English Novelist)

light.title: Light
light.description:
Better to light a candle than to curse the darkness.
- Chinese Proverb (Asian Wisdom)

experience.title: Short Film
experience.quote: Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
experience.author: Desmond Tutu (South African Archbishop)
